# Nehemiah Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 473r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_013_page_001.jpg

---

**13:1** On-that day it-was-read [niqra] in-the-book of-Mosheh in-the-ears [be-oznei] of-the-people, and-it-was-found written [katuv] in-it that an-Ammoni and-a-Mo'avi should-not enter [lo yavo] into-the-assembly [bi-qehal] of-God until eternity [ad olam],

**13:2** because they-did-not meet [lo qiddemu] the-sons of-Yisra'el with-bread [ba-lechem] and-with-water [u-va-mayim], and-hired [va-yiskhor] against-them Bil'am to-curse-them [le-qalelam], and-our-God turned [va-yahafokh] the-curse [ha-qelalah] into-a-blessing [li-verakhah].

**13:3** And-it-was when-they-heard [ke-shom'am] the-Torah, they-separated [va-yavdilu] all the-mixed-multitude [kol erev] from-Yisra'el.

**13:4** And-before this [ve-lifney mi-zeh], Elyashiv the-priest, who-was-appointed [ha-natum] over-the-chambers [lishkot] of-the-house of-our-God, was related [qarov] to-Toviyah.

**13:5** And-he-made [va-ya'as] for-him a-great chamber [lishkah gedolah], and-there they-had previously [le-fanim] been-putting [notenim] the-grain-offering [ha-minchah], the-frankincense [ha-levonah], and-the-vessels [ha-kelim], and-the-tithe [ma'asar] of-the-grain [ha-dagan], the-new-wine [ha-tirosh], and-the-fresh-oil [ve-ha-yitshar] — the-commandment [mitsvat] of-the-Levi'im and-the-singers and-the-gatekeepers — and-the-contributions [terumat] of-the-priests.

**13:6** And-in-all this [u-ve-khol zeh] I-was-not in-Yerushalayim, for in-the-thirty-second year [bi-shnat sheloshim u-shtayim] of-Artachshasta king of-Bavel I-came [bati] to the-king, and-at-the-end of-days [le-qets yamim] I-asked-leave [nish'alti] from the-king.

**13:7** And-I-came to-Yerushalayim, and-I-understood [va-avinah] the-evil [ha-ra'ah] which Elyashiv had-done for-Toviyah, to-make [la'asot] for-him a-chamber [lishkah] in-the-courts [be-chatserot] of-the-house of-God.

**13:8** And-it-was-very-evil [va-yera] to-me greatly [me'od], and-I-threw [va-ashlikhah] all the-household-goods [kelei beyt] of-Toviyah outside [ha-chutsah] from the-chamber.

**13:9** And-I-commanded [va-omerah] and-they-purified [va-yetaharu] the-chambers, and-I-returned [va-ashivah] there the-vessels of-the-house of-God, the-grain-offering and-the-frankincense.

**13:10** And-I-learned [va-ede'ah] that the-portions [meniyyot] of-the-Levi'im had-not been-given [lo nittenah], and-they-fled [va-yivrechu] each to-his-field [le-sadehu] — the-Levi'im and-the-singers who-did the-work [osey ha-melakhah].

**13:11** And-I-contended [va-arivah] with-the-officials [ha-seganim] and-said, "Why has-the-house of-God been-forsaken [ne'ezav]?" And-I-gathered-them [va-aqbetsem] and-stood-them [va-a'amidem] at-their-post [al omdam].

**13:12** And-all Yehudah brought the-tithe of-the-grain and-the-new-wine and-the-fresh-oil to-the-storehouses [la-otsarot].

**13:13** And-I-appointed [va-otserah] over the-storehouses: Shelemyah the-priest and-Tsadoq the-scribe and-Pedayah of-the-Levi'im, and-beside-them [ve-al yadam] Chanan son of-Zakkur son of-Mattanyah, for they-were-considered [necheshevu] faithful [ne'emanim], and-upon-them [was the responsibility] to-distribute [la-chaleq] to-their-brothers.

**13:14** Remember-me [zokhrah li], my-God, concerning-this, and-do-not wipe-out [al timach] my-faithful-deeds [chasaday] which I-did for-the-house of-my-God and-for-its-services [u-le-mishmarav].

**13:15** In-those days I-saw in-Yehudah [those] treading [dorkhim] winepresses [gittot] on-the-Sabbath, and-bringing-in [mevi'im] heaps [aremot] and-loading [omesin] on-donkeys [chamorim], and-also wine [yayin], grapes [anavim], and-figs [te'enim], and-every burden [massa], and-bringing [mevi'im] to-Yerushalayim on-the-Sabbath day. And-I-warned [va-a'id] [them] on-the-day of-their-selling [yom mokhram] food [tsayid].

**13:16** And-the-Tsorim [Tyrians] dwelt [yashvu] in-it who-brought fish [dagah] and-all merchandise [mekher] and-sold [mokhrim] on-the-Sabbath to-the-sons of-Yehudah and-in-Yerushalayim.

**13:17** And-I-contended [va-arivah] with-the-nobles [chorey] of-Yehudah and-said to-them, "What [is] this evil thing [ha-davar ha-ra] you are-doing, profaning [mechalelim] the-Sabbath day?

**13:18** Did-not your-fathers do thus [ko], and-our-God brought upon-us all this evil and-upon this city? And-you are-adding [mosifim] burning-wrath [charon] upon Yisra'el by-profaning the-Sabbath!"

**13:19** And-it-was when the-gates [sha'arey] of-Yerushalayim grew-dark [tsalelu] before the-Sabbath, I-commanded [va-omerah] and-the-doors [ha-delatot] were-closed [yissageru], and-I-said that they-should-not be-opened until after the-Sabbath. And-some of-my-servants [ne'aray] I-stationed at the-gates: no-burden [massa] shall-enter on-the-Sabbath day.

**13:20** And-the-traders [ha-rokhelim] and-sellers [u-mokhrey] of-all merchandise [kol mimkar] lodged [va-yalinu] outside [mi-chuts] Yerushalayim once [pa'am] and-twice [u-shtayim].

**13:21** And-I-warned-them [va-a'idah vahem] and-said to-them, "Why are-you lodging opposite [neged] the-wall? If you-do [it] again [shonim], a-hand [yad] I-will-send [eshlach] against-you." From that-time they-came-not on-the-Sabbath.

**13:22** And-I-said to-the-Levi'im that they-should-purify-themselves [yihyu mittaharim] and-come guarding [shomerim] the-gates, to-sanctify [le-qaddesh] the-Sabbath day. Also [gam] this remember-me [zokhrah li], my-God, and-have-compassion [ve-chusah] on-me according-to-the-greatness [ke-rov] of-your-covenant-faithfulness [chasdekha].

**13:23** Also in-those days I-saw the-Yehudim who-had-married [hoshivu] Ashdodite [Ashdodiyyot], Ammonite [Ammoniyyot], and-Moabite [Mo'aviyyot] women [nashim].

**13:24** And-their-sons [u-veneyhem] — half spoke [medabberim] Ashdodith [Ashdodit] and-were-not recognizing [eyn makkirim] to-speak [le-dabber] Yehudit [the-language-of-Judah], but-according-to-the-language [ki-leshon] of-each-people [am va-am].

**13:25** And-I-contended [va-ariv] with-them and-cursed-them [va-aqalelem] and-struck [va-akkeh] some of-them men [mehem anashim] and-pulled-out-their-hair [va-amretem], and-made-them-swear [va-ashbi'em] by-God, "You-shall-not give your-daughters to-their-sons and-shall-not take [tis'u] of-their-daughters for-your-sons or-for-yourselves!

**13:26** Did-not Shelomoh king of-Yisra'el sin [chata] by-these [things]? And-among-the-many nations [ba-goyim ha-rabbim] there-was-no king [melekh] like-him, and-beloved [ahuv] of-his-God he-was, and-God made-him [va-yittenehu] king over all-Yisra'el. Even-him [gam oto] the-foreign [ha-nokhriyyot] women caused-to-sin [hecheti'u].

**13:27** And-to-you shall-we-listen [ha-nishma] to-do all this great evil [ha-ra'ah ha-gedolah ha-zot], to-act-unfaithfully [lim'ol] against-our-God by-marrying [le-hoshiv] foreign women?"

**13:28** And-one of-the-sons of-Yoyada son of-Elyashiv the-high-priest [ha-kohen ha-gadol] was son-in-law [chatan] of-Sanvallat the-Choroni, and-I-chased-him [va-avrichenu] from-upon-me [me-alay].

**13:29** Remember-them [zokhrah lahem], my-God, for the-defilements [go'aley] of-the-priesthood [ha-kehunnah] and-the-covenant [berit] of-the-priesthood and-the-Levi'im.

**13:30** And-I-purified-them [ve-tihartem] from-all foreignness [mi-kol nekhar], and-I-established [va-a'amidah] duties [mishmarot] for-the-priests and-the-Levi'im, each in-his-work [bi-melakhto],

**13:31** and-for the-wood offering [qurban ha-etsim] at-appointed times [be-ittim] and-for-the-firstfruits [ve-la-bikkurim]. Remember-me [zokhrah li], my-God, for-good [le-tovah].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **13:1-2 Deuteronomic citation** — The reading alludes to Deuteronomy 23:3-5, which bars Ammonites and Moabites from the assembly due to their hostility during the Exodus.
2. **13:8 "I threw all the household goods of Tobiah outside"** — Nehemiah's action is both practical and symbolic: cleansing the temple of foreign intrusion, reclaiming sacred space.
3. **13:24 "Ashdodith"** — A Philistine dialect; the loss of Hebrew among children signaled cultural assimilation that threatened covenantal identity.
4. **13:31 "Remember me, my God, for good"** — The book ends not with a narrative resolution but with a personal prayer — Nehemiah's characteristic appeal to divine memory, leaving the outcome in God's hands.

*— EMET*
